title: Dispatch: olc5.11 repair after cloud review r2 S1-S3 (attempt 3)
description:
Repair PR #663 (eshyra-olc5.11) after cloud final review r2 at fd405d8b: CHANGES REQUESTED (3). Branch eshyra-olc5.11.3 from eshyra-olc5.11 at fd405d8b. This is the third review round: fix each finding AND its whole class in one pass.

GOVERNING PRINCIPLE (captain, apply everywhere in the kept machines): an action taken by the ITEM'S OWNER/USER is an operation executed through use_item (with its typed cost). An action or event of ANOTHER creature (the restrained target, a creature grabbing an orbiting stone, etc.) is NOT the owner's operation: it is an external `condition` transition carrying the full verbatim printed predicate, fired by item_state_event (no owner cost); the DM charges that creature's own action separately with spend_turn_resource. The outcome of the OWNER's operation (e.g. the target's save against the owner's entangle) stays an operation outcome (transitionOutcome) as repaired in r1.

S1 magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts ~711: Rope of Entanglement escape-rope is the RESTRAINED TARGET's action ("A target restrained by the rope can use an action to make a DC 15 Strength or Dexterity check (target's choice). On a success, the creature is no longer restrained by the rope.") but runs as the owner's use_item and charges the holder's action. Closure per principle: restraining->loose on the target's successful escape becomes an external condition with the full verbatim predicate (fired by item_state_event); remove/retire the owner-side escape-rope operation path (check every consumer and test of escape-rope; it was previously in the ready set - report the ready-set change); the release-creature operation (owner's bonus action, second command word) stays an owner operation. Every printed sentence about the escape and unrestraining must be carried (executed or verbatim adjudicated clause).
S2 magicItemFaithfulLifecycles.ts ~613: the Ioun Stone PACK record still carries the r1 fragment condition ('either by making a successful attack roll against AC 24 or a successful DC 24 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check'); the r1 repair changed only the simple-state projection, and the lifecycle edit overrides it. Closure: make the generated pack record carry the full printed predicate (another creature's action -> external condition per principle); add a test asserting the GENERATED pack record's condition text, not only the projection.
S3 magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts ~88: Animated Shield is now executable, but the printed "at which point the shield falls to the ground or into your hand if you have one free" is neither executed nor carried in any clause. Closure: add a verbatim adjudicated clause.
SIBLING SWEEP (required): for EACH of the operations that are ready after this repair (at least animated-shield speak-command-word/end-animation, rope-of-entanglement entangle-creature/release-creature, wings-of-flying manifest-wings/dismiss-wings), list every sentence of the printed item text and show it is either executed exactly by use_item/item_state_event/timers or carried verbatim in an adjudicated clause; fix any gap. Also sweep every condition transition in all 21 kept machines in the GENERATED pack (not projections) for fragments, duplicates, owner-vs-other-creature misclassification.

Regenerate the pack (npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/), verify:dnd5e-srd-pack, regenerate + --check the semi-structured inventory, update the termination census, update count expectations only with source-backed justification. Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: per-finding closure, the per-operation sentence table, condition sweep results, exact ready-operation set before/after.
notes:
Dispatched gpt-6-luna effort high from fd405d8b; PGID 4157512.
Luna stopped before any change (worktree clean at fd405d8b): applied the user STOP condition (3 review rounds with repeated findings in kept state-machine category). Captain surfaced to user 2026-10-14; awaiting decision.
USER AUTHORIZED 2026-10-14: proceed with this repair now (stop condition surfaced and decided: continue). Implement per plan.
Re-dispatched gpt-6-luna effort high after user authorization; PGID 4174521.
Completion report — commit bf8e2958 on eshyra-olc5.11.3.

Per finding:
- S1 Rope of Entanglement: removed owner-side escape-rope from both operation producers. The restrained target’s complete printed action/check/success sentence is now an external restraining→loose condition transition; it fires through item_state_event without charging the holder. The owner’s entangle-creature save remains transitionOutcome on use_item; release-creature remains the owner’s bonus-action operation.
- S2 Ioun Stone: fixed the lifecycle override so the GENERATED pack transition carries the complete source predicate: “Thereafter, another creature must use an action to grasp or net the stone to separate it from you, either by making a successful attack roll against AC 24 or a successful DC 24 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check”. Removed grab-orbiting-stone from owner operations. Added generated-pack assertions for the full predicate and absence of the operation.
- S3 Animated Shield: added an adjudicated clause carrying “at which point the shield falls to the ground or into your hand if you have one free” verbatim.
- Sibling sweep found Ring of Shooting Stars discharge-ball-lightning was also an external creature trigger incorrectly declared as a ready owner operation. Removed that operation; retained its complete printed trigger as an adjudicated clause on create-ball-lightning, with multi-sphere behavior remaining DM-adjudicated.

Ready operation set: 29 before → 13 after. Removed: Ioun Stone grab-orbiting-stone for each of its 14 variants; Rope of Entanglement escape-rope; Ring of Shooting Stars discharge-ball-lightning. The remaining 13 are Ammunition +1/+2/+3 hit-target; Animated Shield speak-command-word and end-animation; Boots of Levitation cast-levitate; Candle of Invocation burn; Frost Brand extinguish-flames; Ring of X-ray Vision activate-x-ray-vision; Rod of Security enter-paradise; Rope of Entanglement entangle-creature and release-creature; Well of Many Worlds open-portal; Wings of Flying manifest-wings and dismiss-wings.

Generated condition-transition sweep: all 21 transitions in the 21 kept machines match a verbatim substring of their generated record description; no duplicate (source state, condition) pairs. Only Ioun Stone seizure and Rope escape specify another creature’s action; both are external condition events, with no owner operation. Census transitions match generated transitions.

Evidence: importer regeneration completed; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack passed with 0 record/manifest changes against regenerated output; semi-structured inventory regenerated and --check passed (1854 rows); verify:worktree passed (363 files, 6785 tests passed; 2 files / 3 tests skipped). No follow-up bead was warranted; all discovered operation-boundary gaps were repaired in this dispatch.
